description: This file defines constants and functions used for handling plugin paths within a software project. It includes path templates, string concatenation functions for generating plugin-related file paths, and exports of these utilities for use in other parts of the project.

methods.name: bundledPluginRoot
methods.description: Returns the root path for a given plugin ID.

methods.name: bundledPluginFile
methods.description: Constructs a path for a plugin file based on plugin ID and relative path.

methods.name: bundledDistPluginRoot
methods.description: Returns the distribution directory path for a plugin.

methods.name: bundledDistPluginFile
methods.description: Constructs a distribution plugin file path based on plugin ID and relative path.

methods.name: bundledPluginCallsite
methods.description: Returns a string representing a specific line in a plugin file, formatted as file path and line number.
